newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB expects to buy extra 14 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB expects to buy extra 14 mln shrs.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said on Thursday it expected to buy a further 14 million of its own shares under its share buy-back programme.
Under the bank's share buy-back programme, announced on March 24, NAB planned to buy and cancel 89.25 million of its own shares starting on April 8.

On April 21, NAB said it had suspended the buy-back. So far 18.41 million NAB shares had been brought back at a weighted average price of A$16.18 and cancelled. The highest price paid was A$16.50 and the lowest was A$15.60.
Brokers to the buy-back were J.B. Were & Son and Merrill Lynch Equities (Australia) Ltd.
NAB earlier reported a 14.1 percent rise in net profit to A$1.14 billion in the six months ended March 31, 1997.
